title: Recording a Standing Monthly Transfer into a Savings or Money Market Account
content:
A standing monthly transfer from a Piedmont Crescent Bank checking account into an account of Savings & Money Market Accounts is put on record as the owner's own instruction. The recurring amount, the day of the month it runs and the checking account it is drawn from all replace whatever stood on the account before, and the instruction takes effect from the next scheduled run. The owner can see the amount, the day and the funding account on the savings account from that moment.

The qualifying recurring amount is worked out only after the account's posted balance carries the relationship bonus owed for every closed statement cycle.

### Recording the instruction

The instruction is recorded with the tool `set_savings_standing_transfer_55216172`. It is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it. One call writes the standing instruction onto the named account.

### Parameters

`savings_account_id` — the reference number of the savings or money market account the money is transferred into, taken from the savings account lookup.

`funding_checking_account_id` — the reference number of the Piedmont Crescent Bank checking account the recurring transfer is drawn from, taken from the checking account lookup.

`transfer_amount` — the recurring monthly amount, in USD to 2 decimal places. A value carrying more than 2 decimal places is stored rounded half up to the cent, and 0.00 is the value that stops the instruction.

`transfer_day` — the day of the month the transfer runs, given as an integer from 1 to 28, or an empty string where none is being set. Days 29 to 31 are not accepted, because they do not occur in every month.

### What the call returns

A confirmation sentence carrying the savings account's reference number, the recurring amount in USD to two decimal places, the day of the month the transfer runs, and the reference number of the funding checking account. That sentence is what indicates the standing instruction is on record.
